title: Constructions for supersaturation of eventown problems
summary: In this paper, we study the supersaturation problems of eventown. Given a family $\mathcal{A}$ of subsets of an $n$ element set, let op$(\mathcal{A})$ denote the number of distinct pairs $A,B\in \mathcal{A}$ for which $|A\cap B|$ is odd. We give extremal eventown constructions and show that for fixed $s\le2^{\lfloor \frac{n}{2} \rfloor}-2$, there exists a collection of $2^{\lfloor\frac{n}{2}\rfloor}+s$ even-sized subsets of an $n$ element set that contains exactly $s\cdot 2^{\lfloor \frac{n}{2} \rfloor-1}$ pairwise intersections of odd size.
